newsitem.title: UK: British leisure chain Rank plans big expansion.
newsitem.headline: British leisure chain Rank plans big expansion.

text.p: Britain's Rank Group Plc said on Thursday it planned a five-year investment programme on leisure sites around the country which should create thousands of jobs.

"With a portfolio of 300 operating units, Rank leisure division plans to invest over 300 million pounds ($490 million) a year every year for at least the next four to five years, in developing new trading opportunities," the company said.
"The division's targets are to open approximately 40 new locations a year, in addition to a large reinvestment programme for existing properties," it added.

Rank, which operates the Hard Rock cafe brand internationally, has more than 70 Odeon cinemas in Britain, along with 31 casinos, some 135 bingo clubs plus more than 50 nightclubs and three live music theme bars.

It said it could create 7,750 full-time jobs as it ploughed money into new locations up and down the country. The investment would represent a 40 percent increase on what it had spent in recent years.
Shares in the British leisure company added 7p to 434.5p on Thursday, extending Wednesday's gains.
The company this week announced that it was selling its film distribution unit to British television company Carlton Communications Plc for 65 million pounds.

Its share price was also boosted by reports in the Financial Times highlighting plans to dispose of its 20 percent stake in Rank Xerox, its office equipment joint venture with Xerox of the United States.
The company confirmed it would not retain the stake, valued at 930 million pounds on its accounts, but said there was no fixed timetable for the sale.
